text.tspan: Our final update is here! We've worked really hard this time around to bring 4 all-new characters, as
well as 7 reworks for existing characters. To be specific:
-SRCast: a low-HP high-damage chaos character focused on gathering guests and leveraging their
unique powers to bring absolute chaos to the game!
-Redd: A medium-HP zoner character focused on spacing far enough apart from opponents to land
-Professor Pistachio: A medium-HP gimmick character focused on racking up damage to create
viruses and deal large amounts of burst damage.
-Jocers: A high-HP brawler character focused on landing combos to whittle down an opponent's HP
Along with two new stages, new fall-off mechanics, and a brand new soundtrack (in the studio or on
Youtube), we hope that this update delivers a satisfying end to Codebreakers.
